name: APMA

core_invariant.rule: representation may change; exact decoded boundary meaning may not
core_invariant.morph_certificate: Decode(M_old) == Decode(M_new) on the declared interface

five_dimensional_spiral: DOMAIN: remove states already refuted by an exact native module
FACTORIZATION: separate independent or separator-factorable relations
LANGUAGE: store each relation in a certified carrier where it is compact
QUOTIENT: merge distinct residuals only under replayable future-equivalence
MORPH: change exact carrier before the current carrier crosses the budget
established_scoped_results: exact query-specific factorization can collapse structurally different residuals when their differences are irrelevant to SAT-existence
open UNATE and 2-CNF components admit exact boundary messages without boundary-cube enumeration
parity-chain projection that is exponential as auxiliary-free CNF collapses to one exact GF(2) row
independent typed open cores remain factorized without Cartesian-product materialization
the frozen C037.2 connected multirow obstruction has exact flat typed-terminal DNF minimum 6
the six minimum DNF terms form a K4/tetrahedral support structure and factor through two OR-block predicates
after restricting routing obligations to the exact affine-reachable domain, the same C037.2 core has exact minimum cover 4 and exact literal routing depth 2
a 57-instance C023/C034 reduction-image census found DENSE_POSITIVE_TRIPLES depth d(n)=n for frozen n=4..8
therefore the current reachable literal-branching grammar is not a universal compression mechanism
known_barriers: unrestricted Horn plus affine composition linearly expresses arbitrary 3-SAT
fixed representation classes can have exponential killer families
existence of a small representation does not imply polynomial-time discovery
adaptive morph selection is invalid if it hides exponential search
finite compression success does not imply an asymptotic theorem
linear finite depth evidence is not an asymptotic lower bound without a family proof
captain_obvious: do not compress impossible states; avoid creating them
do not force every semantic object into one language
do not enumerate all representations to choose the best one
do not let morph selection become a disguised SAT oracle
morph before blow-up, not after materializing the exponential object
a universal material is unnecessary; a universal polynomially discoverable morph path would suffice

candidate_global_measure.message_cost: sum carrier bytes + interface bytes + certificate bytes
candidate_global_measure.morph_path_cost: discovery + morph + update + compare + compose + readout
candidate_global_measure.target: all intermediate and total costs polynomial in source size
